h1: How Ferial Plaza turns the visitor experience into commercial intelligence
sub: Ferial Plaza chooses Flame Analytics to better understand its visitors, boost the capture of first-party data and personalize communication with its customers through a data-driven strategy.

quote.text: Getting to know our visitors better lets us offer more relevant experiences and build a much closer relationship with them.
quote.author: Marketing team

elCaso: Ferial Plaza, one of the leading shopping centers in Castilla-La Mancha, wanted to evolve its marketing strategy toward a more personalized model based on its own data.

With a wide commercial offering and a high volume of visitors, the center needed a solution that would let it know its audience better, improve communication with its customers and have useful information to support future commercial decisions.

To achieve this, Ferial Plaza trusted Flame Analytics to deploy a platform capable of capturing visitor data, segmenting it intelligently and turning every interaction into an opportunity to strengthen the relationship with its customers.

blocks.h2: Moving from the anonymous visitor to the known customer

body.p: Shopping centers welcome thousands of visitors every week, but often do not know who they are, what interests they have or how they interact with the center.
Ferial Plaza needed to transform that reality and answer key questions such as:

list: What demographic profile do the visitors have?
How can we build our own customer database?
How can we personalize marketing campaigns?
How can we increase the frequency of visits?
How can we improve the relevance of communications?
How can we measure the impact of the actions carried out?

body.quote: The goal was to turn the information generated during the visit into a tool to improve both the customer experience and the effectiveness of commercial actions.

blocks.h2: A platform to connect better with every visitor

body.p: Flame Analytics deployed a solution that lets Ferial Plaza offer connectivity to visitors while gathering, with their consent, relevant information to enrich its marketing strategy.

The platform facilitates the capture of first-party data and its automatic segmentation according to variables such as demographic profile, behavior or interests, making it possible to build highly qualified audiences.
Thanks to this information, the marketing team can design more relevant campaigns, personalize communication and improve the relationship with visitors throughout their entire lifecycle.
All the information is managed from a single platform, simplifying campaign administration and providing real-time indicators on the performance of the actions carried out.

Beyond capturing information, the solution makes it possible to activate segmented campaigns aimed at specific audiences, increasing the relevance of each communication and improving interaction with customers.
This strategy based on first-party data helps reduce dependence on external platforms and strengthens the shopping center's ability to build lasting relationships with its audience.
With Flame Analytics, Ferial Plaza has a far more complete view of its visitors and can transform that information into more effective marketing actions.
Teams can analyze the growth of their database, better understand the profile of their customers and evaluate the performance of the campaigns carried out.
This information supports decisions related to:

body.h3: From mass marketing to a personalized relationship

body.p: The project marks an important step in Ferial Plaza's digitalization strategy.
Capturing first-party data makes it possible to build a direct relationship with visitors, better understand their interests and offer far more relevant communications.

Thanks to Flame Analytics, the shopping center turns every visit into an opportunity to generate knowledge, improve the customer experience and develop a more efficient and sustainable marketing strategy.
